job_description:
(Junior) AI Engineer (m/f/d)
ZDF Sparks GmbH
10117 Berlin

Vollzeit

Your Role

As part of our AI Engineering team, you won't just be "helping out": you will be building:

• End-to-End AI Solutions: You design, implement, and modernize data systems and algorithms, moving projects from initial POC to stable production.
• Data Craftsmanship: You work with structured and unstructured data, mastering everything from preprocessing and augmentation to meaningful visualization.
• Model Innovation: You help train and fine-tune models for diverse use cases across text, image, audio and video.
• Explainable AI: You work with open-source algorithms and help make complex AI logic understandable for stakeholders and large audiences.
• Rapid Prototyping: You use frameworks like Streamlit and LangChain to bring ideas to life quickly and test their value in the real world.

Your Profile

We are looking for a "builder" mindset, someone who loves to code and is hungry to learn:

• Tech Literacy: You have initial experience or a very strong interest in designing algorithms and building Generative AI applications.
• The Basics (and beyond): Proficient in Python (pandas, NumPy), SQL, and data visualization. You are comfortable in Jupyter Notebooks.
• AI Ecosystem: You have basic knowledge of ML libraries (e.g., scikit-learn) and are eager to dive deep into LangChain, LLM orchestration, and vector databases.
• Engineering Excellence: You value clean code. Collaborative development via Pull Requests, code reviews, and CI/CD automation is part of your DNA.
• Consultancy Mindset: You enjoy the fast-paced nature of consulting, learning how to translate business problems into technical architectures.
• Language: English (Must-have): Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) are required to effectively interact with our team. German (Nice-to-have): Proficiency in German is a strong plus for collaborating with clients and partners.
